decisions.rationale: Same answer-defining Powered-lift/VTOL proposition: vertical takeoff/landing combined with fixed-wing-style forward flight.

Explicit fixed-wing motion constraint not answer-defining elsewhere: no direct lateral translation; horizontal direction change requires a banked turn. Existing fixed-wing questions cover minimum speed, glide and control-surface axes, not this lateral-movement rule.
Q146 already directly tests that stall makes control-surface operation ineffective/difficult. Adding airflow-separation wording does not create a materially different decision boundary.
Q061 already directly tests swashplate control of rotor-disk tilt and rotor pitch.
Existing canonical question already directly tests the tail rotor as counter-torque and heading/yaw control.
Q148 already directly tests increased rotor count as improving failure tolerance and payload under equivalent motor performance.

Q149 already requires recognition of clockwise/counter-clockwise reaction-torque balance and its deliberate imbalance for yaw. C007 isolates the prerequisite balance statement but does not add enough independent decision-boundary value to justify another item under the density policy.
Same answer-defining yaw-by-reaction-torque-imbalance proposition as Q149.

Tier B PASS. Q132 is helicopter-specific ground-effect recognition near approximately rotor-radius altitude. C009 applies the separate source-defined large-multirotor boundary: broader ground-effect influence near takeoff/hover and higher control demand. Aircraft applicability, operating state and reasoning path materially differ.
Existing canonical question already directly tests loss/unavailability of vision-sensor-dependent functions at night when the sensor is not night-capable.
Existing canonical question already directly tests manufacturer-defined periodic maintenance by elapsed period or accumulated flight time.
Existing canonical question already directly tests IMU composition from three-axis gyros and accelerometers and the motion information they provide.
Q156 already directly tests barometric, ultrasonic and LiDAR altitude-sensing modalities and their principles.

The explicit Ah = current A × time h capacity relationship is not answer-defining in the canonical bank. Q159 tests conditions that change usable capacity, while C014 requires recognition of the Ah definition; the overlap about temperature/discharge conditions is explanatory context rather than the new core relation.
Q161 already directly tests brushless-motor maintenance, noise and longevity characteristics.
Q162 already directly tests matching CW/CCW propeller shape/orientation to motor rotation direction.
Existing canonical question already directly tests ESC control of motor speed/thrust from controller commands.
Q163 already directly tests the electric-versus-engine endurance/noise tradeoff.
Q166 already directly tests multi-cell LiPo balance charging and use of the balance connector.

Antenna radiation/reception strength directionality and operational orientation based on transmitter handling plus aircraft position are explicitly source-defined and not answer-defining in the canonical bank. Existing radio items test multipath/Fresnel/interference rather than antenna orientation.
